data.desc: Founded in 2018, Marti is Türkiyes leading mobility app, offering a wide variety of transportation services. Marti operates a ride-hailing service that matches riders with car, motorcycle, and taxi drivers; offers delivery services; and operates a large fleet of rental e-mopeds, e-bikes, and e-scooters. All of Martis offerings are serviced by proprietary software systems and IoT infrastructure.
